subject: Editorial demo suggestion: one canvas, changing authors
text:
Hi Codrops team,

An interactive demo suggestion for your editorial coverage: I make Take The Wall, a shared webpage where the next activated takeover replaces the current featured message. Its free browser designer lets a reader compose their version and compare desktop and mobile previews before deciding whether to publish anything.

The interesting design constraint is giving different authors the same finite canvas while preserving a legible composition at smaller sizes. The preview uses container-relative typography, and the implementation is public.

Try it: https://www.takethewall.com/?take=1
CSS: https://github.com/sariserhan/takethewall/blob/main/app/globals.css

Would this fit a future Collective link or interactive-demo story? This is an editorial suggestion rather than a Webzibition listing request.

Take The Wall
